name: FNCE 4301
title: Advanced Issues in Security Valuation
description: Valuation of an investment through assessing a company's ability to produce free cash flow, maintain a consistent return on capital and reinvest capital effectively over time; interpretation of financial and management practices; evaluation of the psychological framework and investment thought process that is useful in the analysis of the physical, intellectual and emotional factors related to valuing an investment.
requirement_description: FNCE 3101; FNCE 3302 or 3303; open only to Business majors of junior or higher status.
